verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲਾਰੀ ਦੇ ਮਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੈ ਗਿਦੜੁ ਰਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: neelaaree dhe maT vich pai gidhaR rataa|

en.bdb: Once a jackal fell into a dyer's vat and got dyed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਕਮਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)gal a(n)dhar jai kai paakha(n)dd kamataa|

en.bdb: Taking advantage of its changed colour, it went into the jungle and started dissembling (the animals there).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵੈ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੈ ਅਵਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhar sevai miragaavalee hoi bahai avataa|

en.bdb: Sitting arrogantly in its lair, it would frighten the deer into serving it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਹਕੂਮਤਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਮਦਿ ਮਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: karai hakoomat agalee kooRai madh mataa|

en.bdb: Intoxicated by false pride it started ruling (over the animals) with great pomp.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਣਿ ਪਾਜ ਉਘਾੜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਮੂਲੀ ਪਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: bolan paaj ughaaRiaa jiau moolee pataa|

en.bdb: As eructation indicates the eating of radish leaf, it also got exposed when it (having listened to the howls of other jackals) also started howling.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੀਣਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਪਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: tiau dharageh meenaa maareeaai kar kooR kupataa ||2||

en.bdb: Thus, the dissembler out of his own hypocrisis is beaten hollow in the court of the Lord.
